summary.en: Conan was alone at home; Ran and her father were busy outside. As Conan enjoy leisuring at the Mouri detective agency, Professor Agasa suddenly called him because he want Conan to ask Kogoro to pick him up in the Yamanashi prefecture, due to Agasa's car suddenly stopped working while coming back from a science convention, and had to be towed. Agasa then realized he lost his wallet somewhere, meaning he can't ride a bus even if he wants to. Conan asked why he didn't called "her" to ride a taxi to him, only for "her" (Haibara) to pick up the phone from Agasa and answer him; Haibara is also with Agasa, thus she is stuck with him, too.

locations: A bus stop in the Yamanashi prefecture
On the back seat of the passing car to Tokyo
locationsDropped: Inside Yui Uehara and Kansuke Yamoto's car
suspects: The driver and the passenger of the car
